scope: Resource preparation guide, NOT a validated exact environment or database lock. Nothing is downloaded by quickstart.

python.note: Analysis pins include FastAPI 0.135.3, uvicorn 0.44.0, numpy 1.26.4, matplotlib 3.10.9; root requirements are ranges. Record pip freeze after installation; availability is not guaranteed.

software.name: Nextflow and Java
software.version: not pinned by this reproduction package; record nextflow -version and java -version

software.name: Bowtie 2
software.version: not pinned in repository; index must match tool/reference build

software.name: Kraken2
software.version: 2.17.1 appears in registry example only, not a verified lock

software.name: Bracken
software.version: 3.0.1 appears in registry example only; match Kraken database and read length

software.name: HUMAnN
software.purpose: functional potential, not expression or activity

software.name: metaWRAP
software.purpose: optional MAG workflow; OFF/unavailable in light mode
software.version: not pinned as a reproducible environment

software.name: Ollama
software.purpose: optional local AI repair; OFF in light mode
software.version: qwen3:14b is a configured model tag, not immutable weights

databases.name: host genome + Bowtie2 index
databases.requirements: Choose documented host assembly accession/release; build compatible index; record checksums and command. No assembly is selected here.

databases.name: Kraken2 + Bracken database
databases.requirements: Record source sequences, taxonomy date, release, compatible tools, index inventory hash, Bracken read-length distribution files. No database distributed.

databases.name: ChocoPhlAn / UniRef / utility mappings
databases.requirements: Match HUMAnN release, UniRef90 versus UniRef50 and mapping level. Registry example v201901b mappings are not a promise of availability.

databases.name: MetaPhlAn marker database
databases.requirements: Select exact marker release/index compatible with MetaPhlAn and HUMAnN, record all index checksums.

databases.name: GTDB / MAG functional resources
databases.requirements: Prepare compatible classification and functional databases, tool environment and sufficient RAM/disk before enabling MAG.

warning: Example paths and zero SHA256 values are placeholders, not usable resources. Check upstream licenses, access terms and redistribution rights independently. Exact older releases may be unavailable. No full biological, paper-result or numerical equivalence is claimed.
